_source: talismans/talisman_upgrades/talisman_duplicates/max_upgrade_talismans transcribed from Altpapier/SkyHelperAPI's constants/talismans.js (MIT, credited there to SkyCrypt/SkyCryptWebsite), fetched 2026-08-20. POWER_RELIC entry and perfect_gemstone_rarity_upgrades/non_recombobulatable_ids added manually from Hypixel SkyBlock Wiki research - see lib/accessoryOptimizer.js for how this is used. 2026-08-21: audited every real id in accessories.json (410 total) against this file — 197 were missing entirely (never transcribed, and not present in the live upstream source either); added all of them, plus fixed 3 pre-existing items (FROZEN_CHICKEN, SCAVENGER_TALISMAN, COIN_TALISMAN, VACCINE_TALISMAN) that were wrongly listed as their own family top instead of chaining to their real higher tier. 36 real chains (TALISMAN/RING/ARTIFACT/RELIC/HEIRLOOM suffix families, the numbered CRUX/SOUL_CAMPFIRE lines, VOTER_BADGE, FISH_BOWL, CHOCOLATE, IQ_POINT, PIGGY_BANK) verified id-by-id against the real catalog (existence + non-decreasing rarity) before linking; every other newly-added id has no confirmed chain, so it was added as its own singleton family rather than guessed. Also grouped all 8 Abicase cosmetic skin variants (ABICASE_BLUE_*, ABICASE_REZAR, ABICASE_SUMSUNG_*) as talisman_duplicates of the base ABICASE — user-confirmed mutually exclusive, same rarity, cosmetic-only variants of one accessory slot. Also added the 3 real hat accessories confirmed via a live account (PARTY_HAT_CRAB/CAKE_HAT_2026/PARTY_HAT_SLOTH — none are in accessories.json, hats generally aren't ingested there) as talisman_duplicates of PARTY_HAT_CRAB, same mutual-exclusivity mechanic as Abicase — user-confirmed real names, part of the real 4-member Hat of Celebration family (the 4th, Anniversary Balloon Hat, has no confirmed real id yet so was not guessed/added). 2026-08-21: rebuilt talismans/talisman_upgrades/talisman_duplicates/max_upgrade_talismans wholesale from docs/accessories_list.csv (user-authored, authoritative real-item reference table with per-block starting-rarity barriers and same-row='upgrade chain'/same-cell-'/'-separated='mutually exclusive alternate' semantics) — every id cross-matched by exact name against accessories.json for its real id/tier (Master Skull/Beastmaster Crest/Campfire/Soul Campfire resolved by real-name-prefix expansion since the CSV abbreviates their per-tier names; Book of Progression/Pandora's Box/Pulse Ring/Trapper Crest collapsed to their one real singleton id despite the CSV showing repeated columns, since accessories.json has only one real id/rarity for each). Per the CSV's 'only listed accessories are allowed' rule, every previously-tracked id with no real match anywhere in the CSV was dropped (Bingo Combat/Rift Talisman, Broken/Cracked Piggy Bank, Combo Mania, the whole CRUX_TALISMAN_1-7 line, Garlic-Flavored Gummy Bear, Party Hat Crab Animated, Satelite — 15 total). Not added: 'Harmonious Sugery Toolkit' (row 84) and 'Anniversary Balloon Hat' (row 156) — both listed on the CSV but absent from accessories.json, no real id available to add without guessing.
